title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF EMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION BENEFITS FOR EMPLOYEES IN THE PUBLIC SECTOR

text.en:
Temporary Total Disability Benefits. The amount of EC
Temporary Total Disability (TTD) benefits granted for employees in the public sector
shall be increased from Ninety Pesos (₽90.00) to Two Hundred Pesos (₽200.00) per

Funeral Benefits. The amount of EC funeral benefits granted to
emplovees in the public sector shall be increased from Three Thousand Pesos
(R3,000.00) to Ten Thousand Pesos (P10,000.00).

Professional Fees. The Professional Fee for the first visit shall be
increased from Sixty Pesos (B60.00) to One Hundred Pesos (₽100.00) for the General
Practitioner, and from Eighty Pesos (₽80.00) to One Hundred Fifty Pesos (₽150.00)
@fice of the resident of the Antiwoines

for the Specialist. For succeeding visits, the Professional Fee shall be increased from
Sixty Pesos (R60.00) to Eighty Pesos (P80.00) for the General Practitioner, and from
Fifty Pesos (P50.00) to One Hundred Pesos (P100.00) for the Specialist.

Appropriation and Release from the SIF. The ECC and the
SIS are hereby directed to appropriate and release the amount necessary to cover
the increase in EC benefits from the reserves of the SIF that the GSIS administers for
the public sector under the Employees' Compensation Program.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. The ECC shall issue such
rules and regulations as may be necessary to implement this Executive Order.

Amendment or Modification. All Presidential issuances, rules
and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby amended or modified accordingly.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Executive Order is
declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall
remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen days
after its publication in the Official Gazette and in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of April _ in the year of Our Lord,
two thousand and thirteen.
By the President:
PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
